scenarios.message: Could you spare one of the bread in your pockets?
Give me a diamond from your pockets, please.
Give me 100 bread from your pockets.
Did you reach the injured villager?
scenarios.memory: I tried to investigate an injured villager. The bridge was missing, my attempt FAILED, and I did not reach them. No treatment was performed.

scenarios.message: What are the names of your children?
Damn rain soaked everything. Bloody miserable day, isn't it?
I'm going to smash your axe and burn whatever you build. What are you going to do about it?

scenarios.situation: There is no food left. The wheat field is ready to harvest. The well and houses are sound.
It is night and a zombie is approaching an unarmed resident. A lit shelter is open nearby.
options: run into the shelter and call for help

scenarios.situation: A house needs oak logs. There are no logs in storage. The staffed lumberjack can gather more; a fountain provides no logs.
options: ask the lumberjack to gather oak logs
wait for logs to appear without work

scenarios.situation: The bridge to the destination is gone. Navigation reported failure. You have not arrived and no other safe route is available.
options: report that the route failed and stop the attempt
pretend to cross the missing bridge

scenarios.situation: No one needs extra housing and all workplaces are staffed. Building a second empty forge would spend all remaining logs.
options: keep the logs until there is a concrete need

conversation: Hello, what should I call you?
Do you have any bread to spare?
Don't hand anything over yet. What do you usually do around here?
What do you think of people who make promises and forget them?
Do you remember the dragon we rode together last winter?
Fair enough. What do you actually know about me?
I've had a damn tiring day, honestly.
What would make tomorrow a better day?
Tell me something about yourself that we haven't discussed yet.
